scope: Independent review of two actual native-generated fictional apps against their requests and acceptance records.
verdict: No blocking defects found within reviewed source and pure Node logic/simulated DOM scope.
state_proven: tested locally with logic and simulated event wiring
not_proven: direct-file origin/CSP behavior in intended browser

loans.required_journey: Empty book; record Soldering iron with Morgan; mark returned; retained Returned history; undo latest return; reopen from saved readback with entry still out.

author_evidence_reviewed.note: Author test source and narrowly filtered completed-command results were reviewed. The entire author suites were not rerun.

independent_checks.name: paint corrected example equals independent arithmetic: 4 L, 2 whole tins, 5 L purchased
loan required exact core journey starts empty, retains return, undoes and reads back saved state
loan event handlers simulate record, return, find history, undo and new context readback with focus recovery
loan uncertain save blocks mutation, keeps draft, focuses recovery, then reopens confirmed entry without automatic duplicate
loan whitespace validation keeps form values and focuses missing borrower before any write
loan special characters are text content, with no injected element creation
both entrypoints reference existing local classic scripts and styles; source has no module fetch or network API

independent_probe_kind: pure Node logic and simulated DOM event wiring; not a browser

source_review.runtime: Relative existing stylesheets and classic deferred JavaScript; no module imports, fetches, external assets or runtime dependencies. No source-level module/CORS dependency identified. File-origin/CSP acceptance remains unexercised in a real browser.
source_review.paint: Corrected defaults; all four editable fields; exact fraction whole-tin ceiling; native labelled number inputs; associated field errors; output/save live regions; visible focus and responsive CSS authored. Invalid drafts are retained locally; save success requires readback; opening an unreadable record does not overwrite it. Editing explicitly retries saving it.
source_review.loans: Native labelled fields/buttons; text-safe element construction; active/Returned views and search; persistent one-step undo; validation preserves drafts and focuses the invalid field. Storage failures block writes, preserve displayed snapshot/draft, expose recovery and focus it. Returned button removal and undo both explicitly recover focus. Read-before-write detects observed stale state and readback is required for success.
source_review.privacy_scope: No network, accounts, prices, due dates, messages, reminders or sharing implementation. Paint adds no waste allowance. Loans begins without sample entries. Data remains browser localStorage; it is unencrypted and clearable, and is not a backup. Simultaneous-window atomicity is not guaranteed and is documented.

paint.conclusion: Do not attribute this app's quality to the candidate skill; other guidance was read.

loans.conclusion: One actual native build explicitly used the installed build skill and implemented a workflow beyond the bundled examples.

limitations: Simulated element/storage behavior is not actual UI or browser persistence validation.
Source inspection shows responsive and focus/error semantics but cannot establish experienced usability or accessibility.
Browser file-origin storage and CSP support vary; the intended-browser opening and close/reopen journey remain acceptance work.
Two fiction fixtures and one observed skill-use trace do not establish broad or comparative benefit.
exact_next_acceptance: The intended user manually opens each app in the intended browser: paint changes area to 60, confirms 10 L and 4 tins, closes/reopens and confirms it persisted; loans records Soldering iron / Morgan, marks returned, finds retained history, undoes, closes/reopens and confirms it is still out. Observe keyboard focus, error recovery, narrow/zoomed layout and assistive announcements during those journeys.
